senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; זָבַל) [place of offering or entertainment,]

units: <cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 17a:5">R. Hash. 17ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 9:1:28">Y. Ber. IX, 13ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>פשטו ידיהם בז׳</he> they laid hand on the Temple; a. e.
Ḥag. 12ᵇ ז׳ שבו … ומזבח וכ׳ it is called Z., because there are (the heavenly) Jerusalem and the Sanctuary with the altar erected &c.
